test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won the FIH Women's Hockey Player of the Year at the International Hockey Federation's (FIH) Hockey Stars Awards 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gurjit Kaur **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh** and **Gurjit Kaur** were named the FIH Player of the Year in the **men's and women's categories, respectively.**** **
 
• **Gurjit Kaur** is an Indian **female field hockey player.**
 
• She plays the position of a **defender and is also the team's designated drag-flicker.**
 
• She has represented India internationally, at the **Hockey World Cup 2018.**
 
• She was the **most successful goal-scorer throughout India's Asia Cup title triumph with 8 goals.**** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neha Goyal** is an **Indian field hockey player** and is a **member of the India national team.**
 
• **Monika Malik** is an **Indian field hockey player **who **represented India in the 2014 Asian Games** and was part of the** bronze-medal winning squad.**
 
• **Sjoerd Marijne is a Dutch former field hockey player** and former **coach of the Indian women's national team.**
